==Description==
'''This template should not be used for articles&mdash;see {{Tl|ExcerptIU}} instead'''. This template can be used to format excerpts of text for presentation on talk pages. It is meant to help users discuss changes to article, present alternatives, and/or post references. It is a more powerful alternative to {{Tl|Quote}}, which has traditionally been used in those circumstances.

==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{Excerpt|</nowiki>{{Var|text}}<nowiki>|source=|attrib=|copyright=|width=|background=|color=|font-family=}}</nowiki></code>
===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|text}}}} The excerpt text.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|source}} Used to provide a link to the original source of the excerpt.
*{{Para|attrib}} Used in conjunction with the source field to provide attribution.
*{{Para|copyright}} Displays a copyright warning if specified.
*{{Para|width}} Width modifier.
*{{Para|background}} Excerpt background color.
*{{Para|color}} Excerpt text color.
*{{Para|font-family}} Excerpt text font, defaults to [[wikipedia:Sans-serif|sans-serif]].

==Examples==
===Text only===
====Code====
<pre>{{Excerpt|
<- Your text goes here ->
}}</pre>

====Result====
{{Excerpt|
<- Your text goes here ->
}}

===Source parameter===
====Code====
<pre>{{Excerpt|
<- Your text goes here ->
|source=<- Your internal or external links go here ->
}}</pre>

====Result====
{{Excerpt|
<- Your text goes here ->
|source=<- ''Your internal or external link goes here'' ->
}}

===Attribution parameter===
====Code====
<pre>{{Excerpt|
<- Your text goes here ->
|source=<- Your internal or external links go here ->
|attrib=<- Your attribution information goes here ->
}}</pre>

====Result====
{{Excerpt|
<- Your text goes here ->
|source=<- Your internal or external links go here ->
|attrib=<- Your attribution information goes here ->
}}

===Copyright modifier===
====Code====
<pre>{{Excerpt|
<- Your text goes here ->
|copyright=true
}}</pre>

====Result====
{{Excerpt|
<- Your text goes here ->
|copyright=true
}}

===Width modifier===
====Code====
<pre>{{Excerpt|
<- Your text goes here ->
|width=250px
}}</pre>

====Result====
{{Excerpt|
<- Your text goes here ->
|width=250px
}}

===Style modifiers===
====Code====
<pre>{{Excerpt|
<- Your text goes here ->
|background=black
|color=yellow
|font-family=courier new, courier, monospace
}}</pre>

====Result====
{{Excerpt|
<- Your text goes here ->
|background=black
|color=yellow
|font-family=courier new, courier, monospace
}}
